site: iCIMS / Mutual of Enumclaw; shared authentication and handoff paths
class: Durable and in-memory creation holds diverge after owner review
symptom: After owner Continue clears account_creation_dispatched, an unchanged account form can immediately return FOR_OWNER again.
root_cause: _created_at records an attempted creation before dispatch. f201 clears the durable pending marker but leaves this host in _created_at; account_state next_step still treats the form as an unresolved prior attempt.
why_tests_missed: f201 tests inspect checkpoint aliases without checking the next account-state decision using the existing in-memory history.
fix: After explicit owner Continue successfully clears a previously pending creation marker, discard only that host from the matching memory hold. Keep holds on automatic refresh or storage failure, and preserve already resolved creation history for verification recovery.
validation: Regression returned FOR_OWNER instead of CREATE before the fix; live symptom remains unverified.
prevention: Assert the next allowed action after resuming, not merely that a persisted marker was erased.
